session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend Reversal'. Reading: weak bull trend from the open (H1/H2 pushes, magenta dotted 1-2 wedge trendlines climbing to the complex-top zone at 4385-4387: successive 1-2 tops and an initial 4/2 tag), a low 4 midday reversal with consecutive complex tops and a strong sell signal bar at 4386, then a big breakout and follow-through (10:05) through an iii final flag segment to the 4362 low, with a bear channel at the EMA running into the close (~4362) after one failed ii final flag at 12:30. Weak bull trend from open, midday reversal down = reversal_day (filename title map agrees).
